resources.string: Test all three Anime4K tiers on a real 1080P output using a local 3-second 720P clip. Each tier renders at least 60 frames. Keep the app in the foreground.
Recommended: %1$s, the highest tier measured below 16 ms per frame.
No tier measured below 16 ms per frame. Keeping super resolution off is recommended.
Devices without hardware GPU timers show synchronized render time. Results reflect the current device and temperature; they do not replace physical-device performance acceptance.
The device is too warm. Let it cool down before testing again.
